import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Set up the plotting style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create a 3x3 grid of subplots
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Survival rate by passenger class
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
survival_by_class = df.groupby('pclass')['survived'].mean()
sns.barplot(x=survival_by_class.index, y=survival_by_class.values, palette='viridis', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Survival rate by sex
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
survival_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
sns.barplot(x=survival_by_sex.index, y=survival_by_sex.values, palette='Set2', ax=ax2)
ax2.set_title('Survival Rate by Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Sex')
ax2.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 3. Age distribution by survival
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
df_age = df.dropna(subset=['age'])
sns.histplot(data=df_age, x='age', hue='survived', multiple='dodge', bins=20, palette='coolwarm', ax=ax3)
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
ax3.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# 4. Fare distribution by class
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='pclass', y='fare', palette='muted', ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare')
ax4.set_ylim(0, df['fare'].quantile(0.95))

# 5. Survival by embarkation point
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
survival_by_embarked = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].mean()
sns.barplot(x=survival_by_embarked.index, y=survival_by_embarked.values, palette='pastel', ax=ax5)
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Point', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Embarkation Point')
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax5.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 6. Count of passengers by class and sex
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
class_sex_counts = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex']).size().unstack()
class_sex_counts.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax6, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax6.set_title('Passenger Count by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')
ax6.legend(title='Sex')
ax6.set_xticklabels(ax6.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)

# 7. Survival heatmap: Class vs Sex
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
survival_heatmap = df.pivot_table(values='survived', index='pclass', columns='sex', aggfunc='mean')
sns.heatmap(survival_heatmap, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='RdYlGn', ax=ax7, cbar_kws={'label': 'Survival Rate'})
ax7.set_title('Survival Rate: Class vs Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Sex')
ax7.set_ylabel('Passenger Class')

# 8. Family size effect (sibsp + parch)
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch']
survival_by_family = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean()
sns.barplot(x=survival_by_family.index, y=survival_by_family.values, palette='rocket', ax=ax8)
ax8.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Family Size (Siblings/Spouse + Parents/Children)')
ax8.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax8.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 9. Overall survival pie chart
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
survival_counts = df['survived'].value_counts()
ax9.pie(survival_counts.values, labels=['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=['#FF6B6B', '#95E1D3'], startangle=90)
ax9.set_title('Overall Survival Rate', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

plt.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
